acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shadow rollout compares published readiness with a fresh exact-head successor decision on real non-Draft PRs, records false-ready and missed-blocker signals, and refuses comparison if HEAD moves; no write authority or cutover is granted.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Read-only live parity path added; 139 focused shadow/cutover/readiness tests and Defect Prevention Guard pass.
